items.excerpt: An interesting trend in frontier LLMs released in the second half of 2026 is that they tend to be much better at visual reasoning and creative "design" than their predecessors. If you ask these text-output models to create a 2D image (or a 3D model, as discussed here previously ), you're very likely to get a useful result, and you may even get one that's aesthetically impressive. items.title: Python 异常到底多贵？我把 try、raise、traceback 的账单逐项拆开测了一遍
items.excerpt: 把 Python 异常的账单拆成五段实测：try 在 3.11 上确实零成本（字节码里退化成一个 NOP）；raise 只要 22 纳秒，但 format_exc 是它 96 倍、深栈下 2700 倍；最贵的不是 CPU 而是内存——20 个被存下的异常锁住 20MB 局部变量。
